_note: Scoping probe (GATE 1a): 4 read-only calls, 1 Cost Explorer request (~$0.01). Each key holds the (projected) output of one call. Cost figures in this fixture are the three usage record types (Usage, DiscountedUsage, SavingsPlanCoveredUsage) at AmortizedCost; the m5 Savings Plan usage is therefore included at its effective rate.
3_interpretation: caller account 123456789012 != MasterAccountId 999988887777 -> MEMBER account. Cost Explorer from a member account returns only this account, so no LINKED_ACCOUNT filter is added. Payer variant (not this fixture): when the caller account equals MasterAccountId, every CE call must be wrapped as {"And":[{"Dimensions":{"Key":"LINKED_ACCOUNT","Values":["123456789012"]}}, <other filter>]}, otherwise the numbers are the whole organization.

4_ce_get-cost-and-usage_by_REGION._command: aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-04-01,End=2026-05-01 --granularity MONTHLY --metrics AmortizedCost --filter '{"Dimensions":{"Key":"RECORD_TYPE","Values":["Usage","DiscountedUsage","SavingsPlanCoveredUsage"]}}' --group-by Type=DIMENSION,Key=REGION
